verses.text: Of David. Judge me, O YHWH! For I have walked in my integrity, and I have trusted in YHWH without slipping.

segments.text: Of David. Judge me, O YHWH! For I have walked in my integrity, and I have trusted in YHWH without slipping.

verses.text: Examine me, O YHWH, and test me; refine my kidneys and my heart.

segments.text: Examine me, O YHWH, and test me; refine my kidneys and my heart.

verses.text: For Your loving devotion [is] before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.

segments.text: For Your loving devotion [is] before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.

verses.text: I do not sit with men of vanity, and with dissemblers I will not go in.

segments.text: I do not sit with men of vanity, and with dissemblers I will not go in.

verses.text: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and with the wicked I do not sit.

segments.text: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and with the wicked I do not sit.

verses.text: I wash my hands in innocence, and I go about Your altar, O YHWH,

segments.text: I wash my hands in innocence, and I go about Your altar, O YHWH,

verses.text: to sound with a voice of thanksgiving, and to recount all Your wonders.

segments.text: to sound with a voice of thanksgiving, and to recount all Your wonders.

verses.text: O YHWH, I love the habitation of Your house, and the place of the dwelling of Your glory.

segments.text: O YHWH, I love the habitation of Your house, and the place of the dwelling of Your glory.

verses.text: Do not gather my soul with sinners, and my life with men of blood,

segments.text: Do not gather my soul with sinners, and my life with men of blood,

verses.text: in whose hands [is] a scheme, and [whose] right hand is filled [with] a bribe.

segments.text: in whose hands [is] a scheme, and [whose] right hand is filled [with] a bribe.

verses.text: And I, in my integrity, walk; redeem me and be merciful to me.

segments.text: And I, in my integrity, walk; redeem me and be merciful to me.

verses.text: My foot stands on level ground; in the assemblies I will bless YHWH.
